title: Sprint 4: Advanced Task Operations & Filtering
description: Implement full and partial task updates, task deletion, and dynamic task status filtering using query parameters.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Full and Partial Task Updates
tickets.description:
Implement `PUT /api/tasks/{task_id}` and `PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id}` to update an existing task.

### Specifications
1. Protect endpoint with `Depends(get_current_user)`.
2. Accept `TaskUpdate` payload.
3. Verify task exists and belongs to `current_user`. If not, return `404 Not Found`.
4. Update only provided fields (`title`, `description`, `is_completed`).
5. If `title` is provided, validate it is not empty (raise 400 if empty).
6. Commit changes and return `200 OK` with updated `TaskResponse`.
learning_objectives: Support both PUT and PATCH HTTP methods for resource modification.
Perform selective partial updates on database records.
Enforce resource ownership on write operations.

tasks.title: Implement PUT and PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} updating title, desc, and status
Support partial updates without overwriting unprovided fields
Enforce ownership check rejecting unauthorized modifications with 404/403

common_mistakes: Overwriting description with None when only title is passed.
Allowing another user to modify someone else's task.
hints: Check `if task_in.title is not None:` before updating.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - Delete Task API
tickets.description:
Implement `DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id}` to delete a task.

### Specifications
1. Protect endpoint with `Depends(get_current_user)`.
2. Query task by `task_id`.
3. Enforce ownership check: if task not found or belongs to another user, return `404 Not Found`.
4. Delete task from database and commit.
5. Return `200 OK` with `{"message": "Task deleted successfully"}` (or 204 No Content).
learning_objectives: Implement REST resource deletion with HTTP DELETE.
Ensure unauthorized users cannot delete others' data.

tasks.title: Implement DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id} deleting task from DB with HTTP 200
Enforce ownership check preventing unauthorized task deletion

hints: Raise 404 if `not task or task.user_id != current_user.id`.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Query Parameter Task Status Filtering
tickets.description:
Enhance `GET /api/tasks` to support filtering by completion status using optional query parameter `?completed=true|false`.

### Specifications
1. Add `completed: Optional[bool] = Query(None)` to `GET /api/tasks`.
2. If `completed=True`, filter tasks where `is_completed == True`.
3. If `completed=False`, filter tasks where `is_completed == False`.
4. If `completed is None`, return all tasks for the current user.
5. All returned tasks must strictly belong to `current_user`.
learning_objectives: Parse optional URL query parameters with FastAPI Query.
Apply dynamic SQLAlchemy query filtering based on criteria.
Combine user authorization with custom filter parameters.

tasks.title: Support ?completed=true query parameter returning only completed tasks
Support ?completed=false query parameter returning only pending tasks
Return all user tasks when completed query parameter is omitted

common_mistakes: Overriding user filter (`Task.user_id == current_user.id`) when filtering by status.
Treating boolean True/False as strings manually instead of using FastAPI's automatic query parsing.
hints: If `completed is not None: query = query.filter(Task.is_completed == completed)`.
